name: Pöti
truth: Sugar, wheat flour, water, vegetable fat (palm), invert sugar syrup, egg, humectant (glycerol), starch, carrot (2,3%), glucose syrup, raising agents (disodium diphosphate, sodium hydrogen carbonate), fat reduced cocoa powder, salt, preservatives (potassium sorbate, sodium propionate, sorbic acid), cinnamon (0,3%), emulsifiers (mono and diglycerides of fatty acids, soy lecithin), thickener (guar gum), whey powder (milk), acidity regulator (citric acid), flavouring. May contain traces of hazelnuts.
note: Open Food Facts' text, checked against the photo.
